name: wholesaling-platform
description: Virtual real estate wholesaling platform — acquisitions & dispositions CRM, deal analyzer, marketing, contracts, and analytics.

scripts.vercel-build: prisma generate && DATABASE_URL="file:./prod-seed.db" prisma db push --skip-generate --accept-data-loss && DATABASE_URL="file:./prod-seed.db" SEED_FORCE=true tsx prisma/seed.ts && next build
scripts.db:reset: prisma db push --force-reset && npm run db:seed
scripts.setup: prisma generate && prisma db push && npm run db:seed
